title: The 9 Top Ranked Stocks to Buy Right Now in November (2026)
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; recorded 30 Oct 2026; some fair values garbled in captions
summary: Recorded on 30 October 2026 on a down day (Nasdaq -2.86%, S&P 500 -1.82%), Parkevtate Vosianc names his nine best stocks to buy in November 2026, arguing that soaring earnings and cash flow against flat prices have created better long-term valuations. Amazon: added to his portfolio, AWS accelerating with at least 40% growth forecast for 2027-28, though AI capex annualising above $300 billion worries investors; market a little over $240, fair value garbled. Meta: fair value $928, 26% revenue growth with 12% fewer staff, but AI spend is turning free cash flow negative; Meta AI passed 10 million downloads. Netflix: fair value $120 versus a market price near $62, his largest position, with 30%-plus operating margins and a cord-cutting tailwind offsetting softening engagement. Nvidia: market $205, fair value garbled, his second-largest position, with a GPU-plus-software moat at least one step ahead, though hyperscalers are building cheaper in-house chips. Uber: fair value $122 versus $65, with Waymo going solo as the main overhang. Pinterest: fair value $30 versus just over $19, but he may sell one-third before year-end for tax-loss harvesting and keep two-thirds. Visa: market $414, fair value garbled, over 4 billion cards outstanding. McDonald's: intrinsic value $293 versus $258, with kiosks, drive-thru AI and delivery robots cutting labour costs. Adobe: fair value $349, with high switching costs blunting the AI-competitor threat. Portfolio YTD 7.44% vs S&P 500 11.74%. Calls: BUY on AMZN, META, NFLX, NVDA, UBER, V, MCD and ADBE; PINS a partial SELL (trim, not exit).
